projects.title: Selected Work
projects.description: Three projects that show how I approach integrations, product engineering and business-focused software.

realtime-integration-engine.title: Real-Time Integration Engine
realtime-integration-engine.description: Engineered configurable integrations and real-time product synchronization for enterprise self-service platforms, replacing periodic updates with event-driven communication.
highlights: Configurable integrations managed from the admin panel, with no need to republish the PWA.
Real-time product synchronization using AWS components and queues.
Event-driven communication over WebSockets.
Contributed to integrations with iFood, NCR Aloha/Colibri, TOTVS and GCOM.

order-management-platform.title: Order Management Platform
order-management-platform.description: Designed and developed a custom order management platform to streamline business workflows and reduce reliance on manual processes.
highlights: Built for the operational workflows of a commercial operation.
Designed with the goal of reducing manual controls in day-to-day work.

antero-sistemas-website.title: Antero Sistemas
antero-sistemas-website.description: Designed and developed the corporate website for Antero Sistemas using Next.js and TypeScript, with responsive interfaces, clear service presentation, and email delivery integrated through Resend and Cloudflare.
highlights: Responsive interface.
Clear presentation of services.
Email delivery integrated through Resend and Cloudflare.
Built around discovery and contact.

experience.title: Where I've worked
experience.description: A decade of building software, from an internship in 2016 to senior backend and full stack roles.

highlights: Backend for an AI-powered content creation SaaS, working exclusively on the server side.
Evolved APIs and the contracts consumed by the frontend; fixed issues in agentic onboarding, persistence, visual generation and asset processing.
Worked on Meta/Instagram and Stripe integrations, incident investigation, observability and regression tests.
Delivered web and mobile solutions on demand, covering architecture, implementation and system integration.

Lamp InPunto: defined the architecture and integration flows for the mobile application, connecting the software with custom laboratory hardware and coordinating technical decisions across a distributed team. An administrative management interface is being planned for the next version.
Built an order management platform in Next.js and the Antero Sistemas corporate website.
Built web applications and GIS solutions, including tools to map wells and occurrences on seismic lines.
Integrated mapping services, databases and APIs.
Took part in CI/CD and observability practices.
Evolved the VS Food PWA and led a squad technically.
Developed an integration bot with NestJS and WebSockets, plus integrations configurable from the admin panel and connections to third-party systems.
Automated testing with Jest and CI/CD practices.
Built APIs and solutions for freight quotation, tracking and management.
Contributed to the Frete Cargas app (later Frete Mínimo) and to gamification features.
Improved database performance and stability.
Worked on ERP systems and route visualization tools, integrating location data.
Built a SOAP API and messaging with AWS SQS/SNS.
Developed a Java desktop application integrated with a biometric reader.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with over 10 years of experience building web applications, enterprise platforms and custom software.
My work spans frontend engineering, backend architecture, real-time integrations and business automation. I've also led a squad technically and worked closely with multidisciplinary teams.

I've contributed to projects across retail, logistics, geospatial systems and AI-powered SaaS products, pairing technical depth with a practical approach to business problems and turning operational challenges into well-designed products.
